nodes.label: UI Conventions (Brand Tokens, No Emoji, SVG Icons)
nodes.norm_label: ui conventions (brand tokens, no emoji, svg icons)
nodes.rationale: Color tokens on :root (navy, sun, paper, cal-*), system rounded fonts, inline SVG line icons, motion disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

nodes.label: Schedules Derived On Demand, Never Stored
nodes.norm_label: schedules derived on demand, never stored
nodes.rationale: Schedules computed fresh from members + dates + overrides by buildSchedule.

nodes.label: Settings Tab (Organizer Tools, Copy Code, Leave)
nodes.norm_label: settings tab (organizer tools, copy code, leave)

nodes.label: Home Hero (Create + Join Code)
nodes.rationale: Google's OAuth review requires a public home page that describes the app and links the privacy policy.

nodes.label: Carpool Emails (Welcome, Update, Monthly)
nodes.rationale: Same per-member layout via Resend; silent no-op without RESEND_API_KEY/EMAIL_FROM.

nodes.label: Clerk Session Authentication
nodes.rationale: Without CLERK keys every carpool route answers 503. Pages never sign people in themselves; they redirect to /sign-in.

nodes.label: 6-Character Carpool Join Code
nodes.rationale: Ambiguous characters I/O/0/1 excluded from generated codes; normalizeCode strips them.

nodes.label: Per-Member Addresses Chosen per Ride
nodes.rationale: addresses [{id,address}] plus rideAddresses per leg/weekday; IDs keep ride choices stable across edits.

nodes.label: Two Independent Legs per Activity Date
nodes.norm_label: two independent legs per activity date
nodes.rationale: 'there' (drop-off) and 'back' (pickup) each have eligible drivers, riders and time; availability stored as weekday-number arrays.

nodes.label: Service Providers (Clerk, Google, Netlify, Resend, Apple Maps)
nodes.norm_label: service providers (clerk, google, netlify, resend, apple maps)

nodes.label: Privacy Policy
nodes.rationale: Must be kept in sync with what the app actually collects and who it shares it with.

nodes.label: Most-Specific-Wins Activity Times
nodes.rationale: perDate overrides perWeekday overrides uniform; logic duplicated in backend and frontend and must be kept in sync.

nodes.label: Manual connectLambda Blobs Wiring
nodes.rationale: Netlify only auto-injects Blobs context for native function signatures, not the classic (event, context) shape serverless-http produces.

nodes.label: Create-Flow Draft Saved Across Sign-In
nodes.rationale: Signing in leaves the page, so carpool details are saved to localStorage and restored on /?resume=create.

nodes.label: Fairness Scheduling Algorithm
nodes.rationale: Each leg filled by lowest running drive count (ties: longest since last drove). Solo both-legs driver only when count <= split average, because unconditional solo preference let one always-available member take every date.

nodes.label: Netlify Static + Single Function Hosting
nodes.rationale: No long-running server: public/ served by CDN, all /api/* routes in one Express app wrapped as a Netlify Function via serverless-http.

nodes.label: Lazy Recurrence Materialization
nodes.rationale: Recurrence expanded into concrete activityDates on every read over a rolling ~12-month window with no background job; recurrenceExcludedDates prevents resurrecting removed dates.

nodes.label: Per-Member Unsubscribe Token Flow
nodes.rationale: GET only shows a confirm button because link scanners prefetch; POST sets emailOptOut. Includes RFC 8058 one-click headers.

nodes.label: Local Mode (local-server.js + local-db.json)
nodes.rationale: Runs everything without Netlify on all interfaces so phones on the same Wi-Fi can connect; LOCAL_DB_FILE switch in store.js.

nodes.label: Single-Blob JSON Document Store
nodes.rationale: Whole { carpools } document read-modify-written on every call; no cache, no locking, so concurrent writes are last-write-wins.

nodes.label: Return Mutated Carpool From Store Mutations
nodes.norm_label: return mutated carpool from store mutations
nodes.rationale: Store mutations return the carpool they just wrote rather than re-fetching with getCarpool(), avoiding stale reads.

nodes.label: Strongly Consistent Blob Reads
nodes.rationale: Eventual consistency let writes take up to a minute to reach other invocations: a new carpool showed 'Carpool not found' and stale read-modify-writes undid changes. Requires uncached edge URL passed via useLambdaBlobsContext.

nodes.label: Read-Time Backward-Compatible Normalization
nodes.rationale: Old single-leg shapes upgraded at read time; stored blob never migrated so old and new shapes coexist.

nodes.label: Clerk-Session-Based Authorization
nodes.rationale: Requester identity derived from the session (req.member); never trust a member ID from the request body. Only members can read a carpool.

nodes.label: Legacy Member Linking by Verified Email
nodes.norm_label: legacy member linking by verified email
nodes.rationale: Members from before sign-in existed have no userId and are claimed by a user with a matching verified Clerk email.
